title: Existence of classical minimal surfaces in $4$ and $5$-manifolds
summary: We prove that every closed Riemannian $4$ or $5$-manifold $M$ contains a branched immersed closed minimal surface. That is, there exists a non-constant weakly conformal harmonic map from some closed Riemann surface into $M$. We rely on the existence of multisections in dimensions $4$ and $5$ to generate a non-trivial class of sweepouts of $M$ by mappings from a closed surface $S$ of genus at least $2$.
